docs.title: What is micromanager?
docs.text:
micromanager is a CLI application that manages multiple systems, each with multiple projects, each with multiple compose files.

I developed it because I needed a way to centrally manage multiple systems of microservices where each microservice had its own compose configuration. I wanted a quick and easy way to start, stop and monitor my services.

docs.title: pip
docs.text:
pip install compose-micromanager

The above will install the micromanager executable in your environment. To validate that micromanager is installed run micromanager --help.

docs.title: compose project
docs.text: A compose project bundles multiple application components together.

docs.title: micromanager project
docs.text: A micromanager project contains multiple compose projects. A micromanager project might for example contain frontend, backend, infrastructure compose projects, etc.

docs.title: system
docs.text: A system contains multiple micromanager projects and can represent e.g. a system of microservices.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
micromanager uses a configuration file that is located at $HOME/.config/micromanager/config.json. The configuration file defines the systems to be managed. The expected schema of the configuration file is as follows:

{
  "systems": {
    "system-name-1": {
      "default": "true",
      "projects": {
        "project-name-1": {"compose_file_path": "path/to/compose/file"},
        "project-name-2": {"compose_file_path": "path/to/compose/file"}
      }
    },
    "system-name-2": {
      "projects": {
        "project-name-3": {"compose_file_path": "path/to/compose/file"}
      }
    }
  }
}

If only one system is defined, then that is regarded as the default. If multiple systems are defined however, one must be assigned to be the default.

docs.title: start
docs.text:
micromanager start [PROJECTS]

Start the given projects by running compose up. If the projects argument is empty starts all projects of the current system.

docs.title: use
docs.text:
micromanager use SYSTEM

Set the given system as your current working system.

docs.title: stop
docs.text:
micromanager stop [PROJECTS]

Stop the given projects by running compose down. If the projects argument is empty, stops all projects of the current system.
